== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Path]] of the [[Hungry Deep]] is a [[hunger madra]]-based [[Path]] that remains the most powerful of its kind currently in use. It was created when [[Northstrider]] integrated certain binding{{!}}bindings discovered within a [[labyrinth]] into his [[blood madra]]. This [[Path]] is characterized by its focus on consuming the spiritual and physical power of [[dragons]], as well as their latent Authority{{!}}authority, to increase the user's own strength. While its techniques are generally considered basic, they can achieve high levels of complexity when utilized with a [[Dragon Icon]]. Practitioners of this [[Path]], such as [[Northstrider]], often hunt powerful prey in the deepest parts of the world to bring their acquired power back to the surface. The [[Path]] is associated with figures such as the [[Monarch of the Hungry Deep]] and the [[Sage of the Hungry Deep]].}}
